description: Synthetic reading of the upgrade watch (RULES.md 7.2), made from fixtures/live-healthy (every time moved 3600 s later): the first block the new runtime executed, 3528529. Read on top of a log holding the upgrade-before and upgrade-authorized readings: it reads back the latest finalized head the log holds, 3528478, and the node gives the hash the log holds. The finalized head is the block named in from_results, best two above it; the runtime version is 1014020. state_getStorage of System.LastRuntimeUpgrade answers {"result":"0x12e43d0030747a6b762d72756e74696d65"}, and of System.AuthorizedUpgrade {"result":null} (read at 3528528, the block that carries the upgrade; the lab read none at 3528529); upgrade_answers names where each comes from. Every other value is live-healthy's, made up.
